description: Provocative declaration. Hook = contrarian statement. Body = compare to fictional antiheroes. Outro = invite debate.

hooks: {character} was right. And you know it.
{character} is the most underrated villain in fiction.
This is the take that will get me unfollowed.

betrayal: Every great antihero made the same choice.
Walter White. Light Yagami. Michael Corleone.
Each one chose the dream over the people.
The only difference? {character} was honest about the cost.
We call it betrayal because we cannot face our own ambition.
ambition: Ambition is not the sin. Self-awareness is the sin.
Walter White lied to himself until he could not.
{character} never lied — to himself or to us.
That is what makes him uncomfortable.
He is the mirror we refuse to look into.
default: Read the story again, but quietly.
{character} is not the monster of the story.
Light Yagami did less and we cheered.
Anton Chigurh did worse and we called him a masterpiece.

outros: What would you sacrifice for your dream?
Disagree? Tell me why in the comments.
If this changed your read, send it to your friend who hates {character}.

hooks: You misread {series} on the first watch.
{character} is the most misunderstood character on streaming.
Going to lose followers for this one.

default: Every era's antihero was the same.
We loved them. We made them iconic.
{character} is doing the exact same thing.
We are just not ready to admit it.

outros: Send this to whoever is wrong about {series}.

hooks: {character} es el villano más incomprendido del cine latino.
Esta opinión va a costarme seguidores.
Cambio de opinión: {character} no es el malo.

default: Cada gran antihéroe del cine hizo lo mismo.
Tony Soprano. Walter White. Vito Corleone.
Pero a él lo seguimos juzgando.

outros: Mándale esto a quien no entendió la historia.
